title: CONSTRUCTIVE: cube observable cannot separate; need the resonance-bracket functional

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** `prop:ctvar`, `rem:event` (constructive follow-up to the FATAL gap q1-13).

The solution's own eq. (Fshift) proves that the renormalized **cube** observable cannot
separate $\mu$ from $T_\psi^*\mu$: a single smooth insertion into the 3d resonance,
$\mathbf q_N\circ\psi_N$, is convergent. Hence the distinguishing functional must be a
**different** object — in HKN / Hairer–Peroni it is the **resonance bracket / renormalized
quadratic-variation** observable, where the surviving deterministic divergence comes from the
**mismatch between the renormalization constant adapted to $u$ and the one adapted to $u+\psi$**,
accumulated over the truncation flow.

**Concrete requirement.** Produce $\Phi_N(u)$ (e.g.
$\Phi_N(u)=\langle \mathbf q_N\circ P_Nu - (\text{counterterm}),\psi\rangle$ or the
renormalized energy bracket) such that:
- (under $\mu$) by stationarity, ALL random $c_{N,2}$-divergences cancel, so
  $(\log N)^{-\gamma}\Phi_N(u)\to0$ $\mu$-a.s. for $\tfrac12<\gamma<1$;
- (under the shift) $\Phi_N(u+\psi)-\Phi_N(u)$ contains a deterministic
  $\sim c_{N,2}\langle\psi,\psi\rangle$ divergence ($c_{N,2}\sim\log N$) that NO
  $\psi$-independent counterterm removes, so $(\log N)^{-\gamma}\Phi_N(u+\psi)\to\infty$.

Then $B_\gamma=\{u:(\log N)^{-\gamma}\Phi_N(u)\to0\}$ has $\mu(B_\gamma)=1$,
$(T_\psi^*\mu)(B_\gamma)=0$, giving singularity.

This is the genuinely novel part of Hairer–Peroni and must be written explicitly (or cited at
lemma granularity). The current draft fixes only the *ingredient* (counterterm variable is
$\mathbf l$, not $u$) and stops short of the assembly.

**Numerical pre-check suggested:** verify the constant-mismatch cancellation at the level of
leading frequency sums (as $c_{N,2}\sim\log N$ was verified) before committing to a functional.
